extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value approached by f(x) as x approaches a point.

extracted_concepts.name: One-Sided Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit from the left or right side only.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit at Infinity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Behavior of a function as x grows without bound.

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g(x) <= f(x) <= h(x) and outer limits equal L, then lim f = L.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity at a Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function is continuous at a if lim_{x->a} f(x) = f(a).

extracted_concepts.name: Asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line approached by a graph as x or y tends to infinity.

extracted_concepts.name: Average Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Change in output over an interval; slope of a secant line.

extracted_concepts.name: Secant Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line through two points on a curve.

extracted_concepts.name: Instantaneous Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change at a single instant.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line touching a curve at a point with instantaneous slope.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Existence of a derivative at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiating equations not solved for y.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives of derivatives: f'', f''', f^(n).

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: For 0/0 or infinity/infinity, lim f/g = lim f'/g'.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'(c) = [f(b)-f(a)]/(b-a) for some c in (a,b).

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A continuous function on [a,b] has absolute max/min.

extracted_concepts.name: Critical Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Point where f' is zero or undefined.

extracted_concepts.name: First Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Classifies critical points using sign changes of f'.

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses f'' at a critical point to classify extrema.

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'' > 0 gives concave up; f'' < 0 gives concave down.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization Problem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find maximum or minimum subject to constraints.

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum approximating area under a curve.

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Integral from a to b; limit of Riemann sums.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects derivatives and definite integrals.

extracted_concepts.name: Antiderivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function F whose derivative is f.

extracted_concepts.name: Substitution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Integration method that reverses the chain rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation involving derivatives of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope Field
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Visual representation of dy/dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solves ODEs by integrating separated variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of infinitely many terms; may converge or diverge.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Power series built from derivatives at a point.

extracted_relations.evidence: One-sided limits are part of limit notation.
Limits at infinity extend the idea of limits.
Horizontal asymptotes come from limits at infinity.
Average rate is the slope of a secant line.
Derivative gives instantaneous rate of change.
f'(a) is defined as a limit.
Chain rule is a derivative rule.
The theorem states f'(c) equals average slope.
Absolute extrema are guaranteed for continuous functions.
The test applies at critical points.
Optimization uses derivatives to find extrema.
Definite integral is the limit of Riemann sums.
u-substitution is the chain rule in reverse.
Convergence of series is defined by limits.
